voice.description:

You can preview a voice by opening https://static.aiquickdraw.com/elevenlabs/voice/<voice_id>.mp3 in your browser (replace <voice_id> with the actual voice ID). speed.description: Speech speed (0.7-1.2). Values below 1.0 slow down the speech, above 1.0 speed it up. Extreme values may affect quality. (Min: 0.7, Max: 1.2, Step: 0.01) (step: 0.01)

timestamps.description: Whether to return timestamps for each word in the generated speech (Boolean value (true/false))

previous_text.description: The text that came before the text of the current request. Can be used to improve the speech's continuity when concatenating together multiple generations or to influence the speech's continuity in the current generation. (Max length: 5000 characters)

next_text.description: The text that comes after the text of the current request. Can be used to improve the speech's continuity when concatenating together multiple generations or to influence the speech's continuity in the current generation. (Max length: 5000 characters)

language_code.description: Language code (ISO 639-1) used to enforce a language for the model. Currently only Turbo v2.5 and Flash v2.5 support language enforcement. For other models, an error will be returned if language code is provided. (Max length: 500 characters)
